title: 2 Bdrm Townhouse 8Mins to Brdwy
description:
BRAND NEW 2 Bedroom townhouse w/2 decks! Super quick Uber to Broadway, and just minutes to Germantown, Top Golf, Five-Points, Nissan Stadium & more. This beautiful home features 2 professionally decorated  bedrooms and 2.5 baths with jaw-dropping, chic decor located throughout the home. Each bedroom is equipped with ultra-comfy beds with enough to sleep 6 *Local guests will be further vetted. NO PARTIES.

The space
Our modern townhome is in the heart of hip & trendy EAST NASHVILLE/FIVE POINTS, making it the perfect destination for your stay! Professionally designed with every comfort in mind for bigger groups traveling to Nashville & offering amenities you won't find in a hotel. All in the comfort and privacy of your own space.  So whether you're a seasoned group or first time travelers, there truly isn't a better home in East Nashville! 

LOCATION & PROXIMITY - 

+ Minutes From Broadway via Uber/Lyft
+ Blocks away from Mas Tacos, Dino's and Five Points.
+ Nissan Stadium is a 4 min Uber or a 20 min walk. 
+ 15 min Uber to the Nashville International Airport
+ 6 miles to Vanderbilt University
+ 10 min Uber to The Gulch
+ 5 miles to 12 South

AMENITIES - 

**Check out our complete list in the amenities section.**

• Everything in our home is BRAND NEW 
• 2 outdoor patios w/ lounge seating & views
• Ample FREE street parking for the duration of your stay
• Self check in with a smart lock 
• Free 200 mbps WIFI (unlimited access). 
• 4K LED HD TV's in every bedroom & living room (ready for streaming HULU, Netflix etc).
• Fully equipped chef's kitchen 
• Complimentary coffee bar 
• Linens & towels provided for each guest.
• Complimentary bath products (shampoo, conditioner & body wash).
• Desk in each room for working remotely.
• Every bedroom has an en suite or private bath.

Guest access
Kick back, relax, and get comfortable! You’ll have the place all to yourself and feel like you're at your home away from home!

Other things to note
-Valid ID required for stay.
-ONLY registered guests allowed in building/unit.
